title: Optimality Conditions for Sparse Bilinear Least Squares Problems
summary: The first-order optimality conditions of sparse bilinear least squares problems are studied. The so-called T-type and N-type stationary points for this problem are characterized in terms of tangent cone and normal cone in Bouligand and Clarke senses, and another stationarity concept called the coordinate-wise minima is introduced and discussed. Moreover, the L-like stationary point for this problem is introduced and analyzed through the newly introduced concept of like-projection, and the M-stationary point is also investigated via a complementarity-type reformulation of the problem.
